heroSlides.title: Hero carousel
heroSlides.description: The images and optional messages of the homepage carousel. Changes appear on the website immediately.

slides.title: Slides
slides.hint: Drag a slide, or use the arrows, to change the order.
slides.emptyText: Add a slide with a wide image to show the homepage carousel.
slides.noneActive: No slide is active, so the homepage shows a simple text banner instead of the carousel.

hints.title: Optional. Shown over the image on large screens and under it on phones.
hints.ctaHref: A page on this site such as /products or #contact, or a full https:// address.
hints.altText: Optional. Describe the image for people using screen readers, e.g. “An NIB specialist presenting digital products”.
hints.text: Text is optional and always stays separate from the image. Leave it empty for an image-only slide.

image.desktopHelp: Wide 16:9 photo, at least 1920 × 1080. No text or logos in the image: add text in the fields below.
image.mobileHelp: Optional portrait (4:5) photo for phones, at least 1080 × 1350. Without it, phones show the whole wide image.
image.lowResolution: This image is small ({width} × {height}); it may look soft on large screens.
image.ratio: This image is not {ratio}; the edges will be cropped to fit.

errors.type: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF image.
errors.decode: This file could not be read as an image.
errors.tooLarge: This image is too detailed to compress enough; try a smaller version.
errors.upload: The image could not be uploaded.

settings.title: Carousel settings
settings.description: How the homepage carousel rotates and which controls visitors see.
settings.autoplayHint: Off: slides change only when visitors use the controls or swipe.
settings.pauseOnHover: Pause while the pointer is over the carousel
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

delete.title: Delete this slide?
delete.description: “{name}” will be removed from the carousel.

validation.ctaHref: Add the page the button opens
validation.href: Use a page on this site (e.g. /products) or a full https:// address
